{{External|rs|rsc=Oak Logs|dw=Oak Logs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Oak logs |image = [[File:Oak logs.png]] |release = [[25 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (25 March 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = Logs cut from an oak tree. |value = 20 |weight = 2.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 1521 }} [[File:Oak logs detail.png|left|130px]] '''Oak logs''' are logs obtained from [[woodcutting|cutting]] [[oak tree]]s at level 15 [[Woodcutting]] and give 37.5 [[experience]] points each. Players can burn these logs using the [[Firemaking]] skill at level 15 for 60 experience each. [[Members]] can also [[fletching|fletch]] these logs. [[Members]] training [[Construction]] can bring oak logs to a [[sawmill]] to make [[oak plank]]s at a cost of 250 [[coins]] each. Alternatively, the [[Lunar spell]] [[Plank Make]] can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of [[runes]]. The use of oak planks in Construction increased the price of oak logs. Oak logs are used to travel to the [[Crafting Guild]] on the [[Balloon Transport System]]. Training Woodcutting via oak trees is a fairly quick method of obtaining [[Bird nest|nests]]. 6 oak logs can be used to light an [[Abyssal lantern (oak logs)|Abyssal lantern]], requiring 15 Firemaking. ==Skill info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Oak tree |level = 15 |xp = 37.5 |tree = [[Oak tree]] |tool = [[Axe]] |time = 8.4 seconds }} {{Firemaking info |craftxp = 15 |bowlevel = 35 |pyrelevel = 25 |version1 = Tinderbox |version2 = Bow |version3 = Barbarian pyre |version4 = Bonfire |skill2name = Crafting |name = Oak logs |skill1lvl1 = 15 |skill1lvl2 = 35 |skill1lvl3 = 25 |skill2lvl3 = 25 |skill1lvl4 = 15 |skill1exp1 = 60 |skill1exp2 = 60 |skill1exp3 = 60 |skill1exp4 = 60 |facility1 = N/A |facility2 = N/A |facility3 = [[Funeral pyre (Barbarian)|Barbarian funeral pyre]] |facility4 = [[Fire]] or [[Forester's Campfire]] |tool1 = [[Tinderbox]] |tool2 = [[Bow]] |tool3 = [[Tinderbox]] or [[bow]], and an [[axe]] |tool4 = N/A |type = logs }} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Cutting oak logs}} ==Popularity== ===Free players=== A popular spot to chop oak logs would be at the east entrance to Varrock where there are several [[oak tree]]s or a little bit south-west of [[Varrock west bank]]. Also, due to the close proximity to banks and the fact that oak logs sell for higher prices than [[willow logs]], this area has become a strategic Woodcutting spot. Often, it is crowded since many find it favourable. It is also recommended to go to [[Lumbridge]] since there are a few oak trees behind [[Lumbridge Castle]]. Players [[power levelling]] Woodcutting off oaks can just sell their logs to the nearby [[Lumbridge General Store]]. There are a few oak trees by the [[Grand Exchange]]. You can sell the logs after you cut them, so it is recommended that you cut here. There is another spot in [[Draynor]] right next to the bank. Two oak trees are right there. East of [[Draynor bank]] is another rarely used spot to cut oaks, as most players are busy cutting the nearby [[willows]] instead. There are also two oak trees next to [[Falador east bank]], one right next to the bank and one behind the [[Estate agent]] building. The place is rarely crowded. When training [[Runecraft]] at the [[Air Altar]], one can equip an axe and chop the oak trees on the way to the [[Falador east bank]]. ===Members=== The closest members spot is just north of the Hosidius bank, with a number of oak trees surrounding the bank. There is also a very good spot for [[members]] at the west part of [[Falador]] if you take the [[Agility shortcut]] by [[Falador west bank]]. It requires level 5 [[Agility]]. There are also several oak trees around the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] bank. Another good spot is under the [[Castle Wars]] area. Many oak trees and a bank is close by. ==Tree locations== *[[Draynor Village]] east of bank (4) *Just south of [[Seers' Village|Seers village]] bank *[[Varrock]] South *Varrock East (4) *[[Catherby]] west of bank *[[Castle Wars]] *West of [[Catherby]] *Just north of and in [[Rimmington]] *Just north of [[Port Sarim]] *By [[Yanille]] *All over [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]], including around the banks. *The [[Woodcutting Guild]] ==Products== {{Uses material list|Oak logs}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Oak logs}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 11 July 2005 |update = Farming |change = The item was graphically updated with the release of [[Farming]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Oak logs detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Oak logs detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Oak logs detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Oak logs (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Oak logs (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Oak logs.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
